changelog: New Backtest Results page: Saved Backtests only ever offered Resume, with no way to see how a strategy actually performed. A new 'Results' button on each saved-backtest card (plus a 'Results' link in the replay screen's own top bar) opens #backtest-results:<id> -- session header, 6 stat tiles, a full metric table split Overall/Long/Short (designed so the v3.23.0 gate-checklist clean/not-clean split can add a 4th column later without a rewrite), an equity curve (Chart.js, $ and cumulative R), and the trade list with a CSV export.

Metrics: trade count, wins/losses/break-evens, win rate with a Wilson 95% interval, average R, expectancy R, total R, profit factor, average win/loss R (catches winners that never reach their own target), net $, fees (+ % of gross), longest win/loss streaks, and max drawdown in $ and %. All computed live from closed, non-rewound backtest trades -- never stored.
Sample-size rule: below 30 closed trades the header reads 'EARLY SIGNAL -- {n} of 30 trades'; at 30+ with positive expectancy it reads 'Positive expectancy on this sample'; otherwise nothing extra.

The pure metric math lives in backtest_engine.php (backtestMetricsBlock()/backtestWilsonInterval()/backtestEquityCurve()/backtestResultsMetrics()), with its own self-test against a hand-constructed 10-trade fixture -- every aggregate (including profit factor and both streaks) verified by hand on paper, not just against the code's own output. One real bug caught by that self-test before release: profit factor was splitting gross profit/loss by net_pnl's raw sign, which wrongly counted a Break-Even trade's slightly-negative (fee-only) net_pnl as a loss; fixed to split by the trade's own Win/Loss result classification instead.

New route get_backtest_results (BacktestController) and a lightweight per-session results_summary on get_backtest_sessions, so every Saved Backtests card can show its own 'n trades - win rate - expectancy R' line without a second page load.
release_notes: No schema change this release -- db_migrations is empty, deploy is Update Now + a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R). New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3228.mjs (35 assertions) runs against a 12-trade stateful mock fixture (session 23, stubs/api.php) -- 10 real trades matching backtest_engine.php's own hand-verified self-test numbers exactly, plus 2 rewound trades confirmed excluded from every aggregate. Covers: the raw metrics payload against hand computation, the PHP self-test itself passing standalone, the Saved Backtests card's Results button + summary line, every Results-page panel rendering (tiles/metric table/equity chart/trade list), the EARLY SIGNAL banner at n<30, and a real browser download event for the CSV export (not just a function-return check) confirming one row per trade. drive.mjs, drive-v3223.mjs, drive-v3225.mjs, drive-v3226.mjs and drive-v3227.mjs all pass unmodified. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. Renumbering per the v3.22.7 briefing stands: the risk-ladder engine is v3.22.9, gate checklist is v3.23.0.
